mostWorthwhile.text: Following skin cell division was most worthwhile: the planned pictures connect DNA copying and chromosome separation to the division ring and two daughter cells. The actin-and-myosin ring also recalls the earlier muscle construction.

leastWorthwhile.text: The bone-removal passage felt the thinnest: the result shows old bone being removed but gives little detail about how it happens.

surprise.text: The kidney-to-marrow route was a useful connection: a low-oxygen cue leads to a blood-borne signal and red-cell maturation.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although adding new skin cells to the body was a predictable assembly step after division had already been shown.

continue.text: I would be open to another chapter if it developed connections as clearly as the cell-division sequence, though the mostly sequential choices left limited room for gameplay decisions.
